reason: The ibex bounds back (leapfrog) in its lull instead of hiding in the trees (the coordinator, 2026-10-29). No creature jumps in a fight (Ed's playtest, 2026-10-29: "some animals seem to teleport"): a pack member hidden in its lull (trees, burrow, water, branches) or scattered runs, unseen, toward where it comes back down instead of being put there when its hide ends; a leap goes on along its arc through steps something else holds it (a stun), and one whose target is lost finishes its arc instead of being put at its landing.

frames.*: in a fight with a hiding, scattering or leaping kind, those creatures stand somewhere else after their lull or leap

rules.creatures: the positions of pack members after a hide or scatter, and of leapers stunned or left without a target mid-leap
rules.*: anything downstream of where those creatures stand (the fight's hits, who's near her)
